text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's the final day to make<n>adjustments for the
autumn Tenno<n>Sho. Once we get through this, the
battle with Narita Brian at the Arima<n>Kinen awaits.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide tells me that she's<n>going to get
some rest and heads<n>home, but I stay behind and
continue<n>to gather intel on Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The more I learn about her, the more<n>anxious I get.
My hard work is cutting<n>into my sleep time, and I
think I might<n>be reaching my limits...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm taken by surprise when Biwa<n>Hayahide returns
and starts scolding<n>me for working under such
fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With tears in her eyes, she explains<n>that success
will be impossible if one<n>of us is too exhausted to
go on—we<n>have to support each other. Humbled<n>by
her words, I agree to get more<n>rest.
